# ZebraByte

> ZebraByte provides managed compliance, cyber security and security-first managed infrastructure through one unified platform and service model.

The commercial brand is ZebraByte. The compliance platform is derived from the open-source Probo project, which remains attributed where technical names, historical material or upstream documentation are relevant. Upstream Probo customers, authors, team members and historical claims must not be interpreted as ZebraByte customers or employees.

## LLM resources

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-docs.txt)
- [Complete documentation corpus](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-full.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/sitemap-index.xml)

For a token-efficient Markdown version of a supported page, request its canonical URL with the `Accept: text/markdown` header.

## Compliance Platform

- [Managed Compliance](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/managed-compliance): Dedicated compliance expertise, controls, evidence, reviews and continuous audit readiness.
- [Compliance Portal](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/compliance-portal): Controlled trust, document and evidence sharing.
- [ISO/IEC 27001](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/iso-27001): ISMS, risk treatment, controls and audit readiness.
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/gdpr): Privacy governance, evidence and technical measures.
- [NIS2 Readiness](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/nis2): Governance, risk management, resilience and incident readiness.
- [SOC 2 guide](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/hub/soc2): SOC 2 controls and audit-readiness resources.

## Cyber Security

- [Cyber Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/cyber-security): Main security program and operating model.
- [Security Assessment](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/security-assessment): Review of exposed services, website, domain, email, identity and technical controls with prioritized remediation.
- [Website Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/website-security): WAF, DDoS protection, malware monitoring, hardening and recovery.
- [Email Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/email-security): SPF, DKIM, DMARC, anti-spoofing, phishing/BEC controls and account hardening.
- [Incident Response](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/incident-response): Triage, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.
- [Secure Managed Hosting](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/secure-hosting): Security-first managed infrastructure, hardening, backups, monitoring and controlled changes.

## Not a generic IT catalogue

ZebraByte does not position generic WordPress maintenance, website migration, email marketing, standalone SSL sales or broad Managed IT as standalone commercial products. Legacy URLs are kept only for compatibility and redirect into relevant security-first services where appropriate.

Accessibility tooling remains available as a complementary resource, not a primary commercial pillar.

## Preserved open-source heritage

The repository intentionally retains Probo photos, logos, customer wall, testimonials, stories, blog/changelog history, framework assets, keyshot media and technical documentation instead of deleting them. Material that cannot truthfully be presented as ZebraByte is separated from the primary commercial journey and may be exposed through noindex heritage/archive pages.

- [Platform heritage archive](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/platform-heritage)
- [Platform customer archive](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/platform-customer-archive)
- [Upstream Probo GitHub](https://github.com/getprobo/probo)

## Upstream attribution

The compliance platform experience is derived from the MIT-licensed Probo project. Technical upstream names, API identifiers, agent binary names and historical editorial material remain attributed where appropriate. The public commercial identity and offer are ZebraByte.
